description: Homograph / look-alike domain check — Check one domain or URL for spoofing tricks before trusting a link: decodes xn-- punycode to Unicode, finds mixed-script labels (Latin+Cyrillic), whole-script Cyrillic/Greek look-alikes, ASCII swaps (rn→m, 0→o, 1→l, vv→w), 1-2 letter typos and brand names hidden in longer labels or subdomains (paypal.com.evil.top) against ~170 commonly phished brands, plus risky TLDs and credential-bait words. Returns unicode + ascii forms, scripts per label, what it reads as, the brand it imitates, a 0-100 risk score and verdict LIKELY SPOOF / SUSPICIOUS / LOW RISK / NO HOMOGRAPH SIGNS. Param: domain= (or url=). Offline name analysis. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_idn_check
